changes.title: Tabbed settings
changes.description: Settings now uses dedicated tabs for Network, Database & Loot, Character, Garmoth, Overlay, Keybinds, and Ignore List. The active tab is underlined, and Save Changes stays visible at the bottom.

changes.title: Storage filtering
changes.description: Storage and Transaction Maid withdrawals detected by the tested transfer packet are no longer counted as loot.

changes.title: Overlay improvements
changes.description: Overlay position saving is more reliable, a reset button was added, and the loot list can now be sorted by quantity, last loot time, total value, or unit price.

changes.title: System Tray
changes.description: Closing the main window now lets you exit, cancel, or keep the tracker running in the system tray while the overlay remains available.

changes.title: Global keybinds
changes.description: Optional global shortcuts can toggle Start / Stop Tracking and Overlay ON / OFF, even while BDO is focused or the tracker is in the tray.

changes.title: New update experience
changes.description: If an update is already available when BDO Loot Tracker starts, a styled in-app prompt offers Later or Update now. Updates discovered while the program is already running remain a compact bottom-right Update available / Click here notification, with background checks continuing while the app is open.

changes.title: Reliable post-update changelog
changes.description: After an update and restart, the What's New window is shown reliably after the main window has rendered. Pending update markers remain until the changelog was actually displayed, and a fallback message is shown if detailed changelog data is unavailable.

changes.title: Unified BDO Loot Tracker dialogs
changes.description: Standard Windows message boxes used by the tracker were replaced with shared dark in-app dialogs so information, warnings, errors and confirmations match the rest of the application.

changes.title: Garmoth upload review and editing
changes.description: Upload to Garmoth now opens a compact review window first. Loot quantities can be corrected for the outgoing upload without changing the original packet-tracked loot, while previously uploaded sessions are clearly marked with their last upload time and upload count.

changes.title: Session Drop Rate metadata
changes.description: Drop Rate is stored as local session metadata and can be edited directly from the expanded Session History card. The same saved value is reused by the Garmoth upload preview and generated session screenshots. Unknown Drop Rate is shown as — instead of 0%.

changes.title: Session History redesigned around grind spots
changes.description: Session History starts on All Spots and includes a left-side list of grind spots you actually visited. Selecting a spot filters the session cards and recalculates Total Silver, Silver/hr, Trash/hr and Total Time for that selection.

changes.title: Compact expandable session cards
changes.description: Sessions are shown as compact cards with class/spec, silver/hr, trash/hr and main-loot icon previews. Cards can still be expanded for full loot details, while Upload to Garmoth, Generate Screenshot and Delete Session are available directly before expansion.

changes.title: Shareable session screenshot workflow
changes.description: Generate Screenshot opens an in-app preview with Copy, Save As and Close. The share card includes the tracker branding, grind spot and session details, a compact two-row stat layout and icon-only acquired loot with quantity badges.

changes.title: Sharper and cleaner session cards
changes.description: Session screenshots render at 2x resolution for cleaner text and item icons. The card now has rounded outer corners, uses the same transparent header logo as the main window, and keeps a compact share-friendly width.

changes.title: Refined acquired-loot badges
changes.description: Loot quantity labels are now smaller, more transparent and fully contained inside each item tile instead of extending beyond the item border. Values such as x12,641 remain readable while larger quantities can use compact K / M / B formatting.

changes.title: Garmoth preview visual refinements
changes.description: The Garmoth upload window is tighter and its loot editor uses consistent dark rows and cells so quantities, prices and totals remain easy to read.

changes.title: Windows-only platform cleanup
changes.description: The Windows-only main window is explicitly marked for the Windows platform so tray-icon and other intentional Windows API usage no longer produces unnecessary cross-platform analyzer warnings.

changes.title: Storage and Maid transfer filtering
changes.description: Storage and Transaction Maid withdrawals are now suppressed with a short packet lookback window instead of requiring the transfer marker to sit immediately next to the loot candidate. The filter remains data-driven in the parser JSON.

changes.title: Central Market transfer protection kept
changes.description: The existing Central Market withdrawal marker remains part of the parser profile, so Market, Storage and Maid inventory transfers share the same transfer-suppression path instead of being counted as grind loot.

changes.title: ExitLag compatibility mode
changes.description: Settings → Network now includes an optional ExitLag mode. It scans dynamic TCP relay ports for the BDO loot signature instead of assuming source port 8889, locks one valid relay, ignores mirrored duplicate relays and can fail over if the selected relay stops receiving traffic.

changes.title: Capture diagnostics
changes.description: Network Settings shows the last capture mode plus accepted loot and suppressed-transfer counts. ExitLag sessions also report the locked relay and how many duplicate relay streams were observed.

changes.title: Updated parser profile
changes.description: The built-in and GitHub-ready EU parser profile was advanced to EU-2026.09.05.1 with a 96-byte transfer lookback and the tested Central Market, Storage and Maid markers.

changes.title: ExitLag relay detection warning
changes.description: Enabling ExitLag mode now shows a themed warning explaining that relay discovery can take a short moment after START. Start tracking before grinding and wait for the ExitLag relay status; the first 1–2 loot events can be missed while the relay is still being identified.

changes.title: State-based Storage / Maid suppression
changes.description: Transfer filtering no longer depends only on a short byte lookback. A detected Market, Storage or Maid marker now arms a one-shot suppression state for the next valid inventory-add candidate, with a short timeout so later real mob loot is not swallowed.

changes.title: Additional Storage transfer variant
changes.description: The EU parser profile now recognizes the additional 28 00 00 BE 16 Storage transfer frame observed in the second ExitLag capture. This closes the variant that could previously be counted as loot.

changes.title: ExitLag cross-relay transfer protection
changes.description: If one ExitLag relay identifies a transfer but a mirrored relay misses the marker because of different TCP segmentation, the matching mirrored inventory-add event is suppressed before it can lock the tracker onto the wrong relay or enter session loot.

changes.title: Parser profile EU-2026.09.05.2
changes.description: Built-in and GitHub parser profiles were advanced to EU-2026.09.05.2 with the new Storage marker, 2-second one-shot transfer state and updated manifest hash.
